status: provisional B decision, 30 October. Scope widened the same morning to all eight categories at Athul's request, before any AD 2 output (validation or test) was read; fabric and vial were the first choice. The team may revise passes, and C may revise the lighting ranges (which requires rerunning B1/B2).
scope: AD 2 B0/B1/B2 training for the proposal's main claim. Thresholds and regular/changed-lighting evaluation are D's.
input: full-frame bilinear resize to 256 x 256 with no crop, the AD 2 paper's default for its baselines; non-square images change aspect ratio
validation: official validation/good folder, regular lighting only
category_policy: fabric (prepared) plus further categories chosen from normal image counts, native size and measured cost only, never from test images, test lighting or server feedback
category_counts_source: paper Table IV (arXiv:2503.21622v1) via docs/ad2-data-audit.md; fabric confirmed on disk (manifest 6f9c589c...). sheet_metal is below the validation minimum.
horizon_note: 80 source passes with two views is 160 input-view passes, the rule used for the MVTec AD study and the same count as the upstream single-view recipe (40 meta-epochs x 4). 160 source passes matches the paper's 160 epochs per view and doubles cost. Fabric at batch 8 is 49 updates per pass: 3,920 or 7,840 updates.
cost_note: measure the paired step cost at 256 on fabric before choosing; decoding 2448 x 2048 PNGs may dominate
lighting_status: confirmed by C on 30 October: 0.8 to 1.2 for both B1 and B2, the same ranges as the MVTec AD study

weight_search.data: AD 2 official normal validation; the MVTec AD selection (1.0) is not carried over
weight_search.controls: one B1 run per category at the tuning seed, shared by all candidates
weight_search.proxy: category-macro mean of B2/B1 normal-validation patch-score MSE ratios at the four fixed brightness/gamma corners
weight_search.tie_rule: smallest positive weight within 1 percent of the best eligible proxy
weight_search.no_eligible_candidate: stop; do not silently change the safeguards or launch B2
weight_search.categories: all eight; one shared weight from the category-macro proxy
weight_search.outcome: 30 October: no candidate met the safeguards in all eight categories; the synthetic-hinge ratio exceeded 1.25 in three or four categories at every weight, including 0.01.
weight_search.deviation: Recorded the same day, before any AD 2 B2 main run finished: B2 is trained anyway at the fixed weight 1.0 that the MVTec AD study selected on 27 October, before any AD 2 data, and is reported as a deviation from the stop rule. 1.0 was not picked from the AD 2 search, where it failed in can, fruit_jelly, rice and vial.

hardware: one NVIDIA A40 per run; up to three runs may share one GPU (byte-identical checkpoints verified on MVTec AD)
selection_note: all eight categories. sheet_metal has 19 normal-validation images, below the 20 the MVTec AD study required; it is included at Athul's request and its validation-based threshold and diagnostics rest on 19 images. No image, score or test data was read.
reporting: per-category results for all eight, plus two category-macro averages: all eight, and the seven without sheet_metal because of its 19-image validation set. Fixed on 30 October before this study scored any test image; by then only vial's normal-validation diagnostics had been read.
horizon_decision: 80, the MVTec AD rule (160 input-view passes). A synthetic 2448 x 2048 PNG probe measured 1.68 s per paired step at 256, so 160 passes would double an already long matrix.
